items.stem: Which TWO steps are appropriate before sharing an AI-assisted deck externally? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Verify factual claims in the generated content
options.rationale: Correct: AI claims must be checked before external use.

options.text: Confirm sensitive data use complies with policy
options.rationale: Correct: data-handling policy governs source material.

options.text: Assume generated images are always licence-free for any use

options.rationale: Skipping review risks errors and policy breaches.
